model_annotation: This plot illustrates the relationship between co-occurrence number and accuracy (ACC) for various methods. The x-axis is labeled "Co-occurrence Number" and has a logarithmic scale, ranging from $10^0$ to $10^3$, with tick labels at $10^0$, $10^1$, $10^2$, and $10^3$. The y-axis is labeled "ACC (%)" and has a linear scale, ranging from 60 to 80, with tick labels at intervals of 5. There are five lines in the plot, each representing a different method: Base (black, solid, with circles), FT (blue, solid, with triangles), IKE (red, solid, with triangles), MEMIT (purple, solid, with diamonds), MEND (brown, solid, with diamonds), and ROME (green, solid, with squares). The Base line starts at around 62 and increases to around 68; the FT line starts at around 65 and increases to around 72; the IKE line starts at around 66 and increases to around 74; the MEMIT line starts at around 69 and increases to around 76; the MEND line starts at around 70 and increases to around 78; and the ROME line starts at around 74 and increases to around 84.
